articles.headline: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska

article.story: Michigan State (2-6) at Michigan (5-3), Nov. 7 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Michigan by 12.5. Against the spread: Michigan 3-5, Michigan State 4-3-1. How to watch: Peacock Key stats Michigan Offense Overall: 316.4 yards per game (129th in FBS) Passing: 178.4 yards per game (119th) Rushing: 138 yards per game (98th) Scoring: 21.3 points per game (114th) Michigan Defense Overall: 250 yards per game (3rd in FBS) Passing: 150.6 yards per game (5th) Rushing: 99.4 yards per game (17th) Scoring: 16.4 points per game (18th) Michigan State Offense Overall: 291.4 yards per game (134th in FBS) Passing: 181.3 yards per game (117th) Rushing: 110.1 yards per game (122nd) Scoring: 19.9 points per game (123rd) Michigan State Defense Overall: 355.1 yards per game (64th in FBS) Passing: 201.4 yards per game (50th) Rushing: 153.8 yards per game (86th) Scoring: 25.8 points per game (85th) Michigan State is 105th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 41.3% of the time. Michigan ranks 37th on offense, converting on 43.9% of third downs. Michigan State ranks 125th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin. Michigan ranks 94th in the FBS averaging 62.5 penalty yards per game, compared to Michigan State's 17th-ranked 41.6 per-game average. Both teams have weak red zone defenses. Michigan State is 112th in FBS, allowing opponents to score on 90% of trips. Michigan's red zone defense ranks 127th, with opponents scoring on 94.7% of red zone trips. Team leaders Michigan Passing: Bryce Underwood, 924 yards, 5 TDs, 6 INTs, 58.1 completion percentage Rushing: Jordan Marshall, 319 yards on 86 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: J.J. Buchanan, 602 yards on 38 catches, 5 TDs Michigan State Passing: Alessio Milivojevic, 1,263 yards, 7 TDs, 3 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jaziun Patterson, 327 yards on 76 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Chrishon McCray, 289 yards on 29 catches, 1 TD Last game Michigan beat Rutgers 28-21 on Oct. 31. Tommy Carr led Michigan with 266 yards on 22-of-27 passing (81.5%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 12 times for 54 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Savion Hiter carried the ball 20 times for 76 yards, adding one reception for four yards. Buchanan had five receptions for 63 yards and one touchdown. Michigan State lost 28-10 to UCLA on Oct. 24. Leo Hannan threw for 67 yards on 9-of-15 attempts (60.0%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Kenneth Williams carried the ball 17 times for 54 yards, adding three receptions for 12 yards and one touchdown. McCray put up 42 yards on three catches. Next game Michigan plays at Oregon on Nov. 14. Michigan State hosts Washington on Nov. 14.
